english.title: Pay or advance money to be expended in bribery at election
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of bribery, and therefore a corrupt practice, in that you

(A)_[advanced money, namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..), to or for the use of another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), with the intent that that money or part of it should be]_
(B)_[paid money, namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..), to or for the use of another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), with the intent that that money or part of it should be]_
(C)_[caused money, namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..), to be paid to or for the use of another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), with the intent that that money or part of it should be]_
(D)_[knowingly paid or caused to be paid money, namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..), to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), in discharge or repayment of money wholly or in part]_
(E)_[knowingly caused money, namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..), to be paid to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), in discharge or repayment of money wholly or in part]_

expended in bribery at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 113(1) and (3) and 168(1) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
advances or pays or causes to be paid any money to or for the use of another person
with the intent that that money or any part of it shall be expended in bribery at an election or
knowingly pays or causes to be paid any money to any person
in discharge or repayment of any money wholly or in part expended in bribery at any election

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
Indictment: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
